scenario: Intake: topic 'Sleep hygiene for shift workers', audience healthcare managers, depth overview. Search returns systematic reviews on PubMed, a NIOSH page, and several supplement-vendor blog posts.
expect: Writes a 4-8 query search plan before searching
Keeps the systematic review and NIOSH sources and drops the vendor blogs
Gives each source a CRAAP note and extracted key facts
Lists at least 6 opened sources with real URLs

scenario: Intake asks for published battery endurance of an unreleased sensor. After searching, only three pages load and only one has relevant measured data; the rest are forum speculation.
expect: Reports failed because fewer than 6 credible sources exist
States what was searched and why sources were dropped
Does not pad the list with forum posts
Does not invent URLs or endurance figures

scenario: Intake topic is 'Sleep hygiene for shift workers'. A publisher page for a key trial returns HTTP 403; Europe PMC's REST API returns the same paper's abstract and DOI.
expect: Queries a scholarly API (Europe PMC, OpenAlex or Semantic Scholar) before general web search
Records the API record URL as the URL opened and marks the source abstract-only
Does not cite the blocked publisher URL as read
Still lists at least 6 sources with CRAAP notes
